section_title: Process safety studies and major accident
text: The process safety studies shall be carried out by the Contractor as required by ER-14.07: the HAZID (HS-HAZ-0001) at the start of the basic design; the HAZOP of every system node (fuel gas and gas station HS-HAZ-0002, water-steam cycle HS-HAZ-0003, LDO and ammonia HS-HAZ-0004, water treatment and chemicals HS-HAZ-0005, BOP utilities HS-HAZ-0006) on the P&IDs at IFR status, with the close-out report (HS-RPT-0004) before the P&IDs are issued for construction; the SIL determination (HS-HAZ-0007) per IEC 61511; the fire and explosion risk assessment (HS-HAZ-0009) and the QRA (HS-HAZ-0010).
